title: Property, Plant, and Equipment
summary: Withdrawn standard. IPSAS 17 Property, Plant and Equipment was superseded for periods beginning 1 January 2025 by IPSAS 45, a comprehensively updated Standard issued as part of the 2023 Standards package (May 2023). Retained as a numbering placeholder with a redirect map.
description: IPSAS 17 Property, Plant and Equipment was withdrawn; superseded by IPSAS 45 (effective periods beginning 1 January 2025). Retained as a numbering placeholder.
